 - 
 Wat ga je doen? 
As a part-time mail carrier at PostNL in Sevenum, you make sure everyone receives their mail on time. You can organise your own schedule, which makes this job very flexible. 
Your day starts at the depot in your neighbourhood, where you collect the mail for your route. You sort the letters and get your bike ready. Then you're ready to go! You cycle through the streets in your area and deliver mail to the correct addresses. Along the way, you enjoy the fresh air and often have a chat with people you meet. 
This vacancy is for 3 hours per day from Wednesday, Friday and Saturday, which adds up to 9 hours per week. You can choose your own starting time, as long as all mail is delivered before 6:00 PM. This gives you the freedom to organise your work in the way that suits you best. 
Are you 16 years or older, do you speak Dutch or English, and do you enjoy being outdoors? Apply now and start delivering letters and cards in one of our neighbourhoods in the region soon! 
Please note: the position is initially until the end of September. 
 Waar ga je werken? 
You will be working at PostNL, the largest postal and parcel company in the Netherlands. Every day, they ensure that millions of letters and parcels are delivered to the right destination, both within the Netherlands and abroad. 
As a mail carrier, you work independently. You start your day by collecting the mail and have until 6:00 PM to sort and deliver everything. This allows you to largely determine your own pace and how you organise your day. 
The location is accessible from Venray, Horst, America, Hegelsom, Meterik, Sevenum, Melderslo and Grubbenvorst. Do you live in one of these places? If so, you may even be able to cycle to the depot. Do you enjoy working independently outdoors and making people happy with their mail? Then this is the perfect job for you!
